name: swapFactorsAux
statement: ∀ (l : List α) (f : Perm α), (∀ {x}, f x ≠ x → x ∈ l) → { l : List (Perm α) // l.prod = f ∧ ∀ g ∈ l, IsSwap g } | [] => fun f h => ⟨[], Equiv.ext fun x => by rw [List.prod_nil] exact (Classical.not_not.1 (mt h List.not_mem_nil)).symm, by simp⟩ | x::l => fun f h => if hfx : x = f x then swapFactorsAux l f fun {y} hy => List.mem_of_ne_of_mem (fun h : y = x => by simp [h, hfx.symm] at hy) (h hy) else let m

name: isConj_swap
statement: α} (hwx : w ≠ x) (hyz : y ≠ z) : IsConj (swap w x) (swap y z)

name: signAux_eq_signAux2
statement: ℕ} : ∀ (l : List α) (f : Perm α) (e : α ≃ Fin n) (_h : ∀ x, f x ≠ x → x ∈ l), signAux ((e.symm.trans f).trans e) = signAux2 l f | [], f, e, h => by have : f = 1

name: sign_subtypePerm
statement: Perm α) {p : α → Prop} [DecidablePred p] (h₁ : ∀ x, p (f x) ↔ p x) (h₂ : ∀ x, f x ≠ x → p x) : sign (subtypePerm f h₁) = sign f

name: sign_bij
statement: Perm α} {g : Perm β} (i : ∀ x : α, f x ≠ x → β) (h : ∀ x hx hx', i (f x) hx' = g (i x hx)) (hi : ∀ x₁ x₂ hx₁ hx₂, i x₁ hx₁ = i x₂ hx₂ → x₁ = x₂) (hg : ∀ y, g y ≠ y → ∃ x hx, i x hx = y) : sign f = sign g
